title: Determination of the oral microbiome and the microbiome of an implant affected by peri-implantitis in the irradiated patient
summary: The aim of the study, in which we ask you to participate, is to determine the composition of both the oral microbiome and the microbiome of an inflammation around a dental implant in patients after radiotherapy with the help of two swabs.

interventions.name:
Examination of the the oral microbiome iand the microbiome of peri-implanttis (dental implant) n patients following radiation therapy (RT
One-time evaluation of biosamples in the form of swabs/paper tip swabs using the shotgun sequencing service

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Completed radiotherapy ≥36 Gy, peri-implant infection, implants ≥ 6 months, prosthetically treated
Exclusion criteria:
Patients with dementia or patients with other cognitive impairments who are unable to consent to the study, patients who participate in the study for other reasons disagree
